airframe.name: PORTAL_MVP_01

motor_layout.wing_roles: two lift and one cruise per side

airframe.notes: 120 kg baseline; OBJ-fitted UIUC wing revision of CONCEPT_04. Matched ATLAS_JO_05B (1).obj upper-shell leading/trailing edges with 16 mirrored wing segments at native OBJ scale (assumed metres). OBJ -Z forward, +X right, -Y down; pitch registration +23.081844 deg preserves the baseline root chord attitude. NACA23018/23012 UIUC sections retained, not arbitrary OBJ skins. Rear/cruise mount heights follow revised wing chord surfaces; contact pads follow nose/tips. Aerodynamics and ground posture require simulation revalidation. Revised 2026-09-23: UIUC NACA 66-018 double-arc centerbody fitted to upper and lower OBJ contours, smoothly blending into UIUC S1210 high-lift outer wings. 60 mm constraint withdrawn. Static predicted wing lift reaches weight near 24.25 deg body pitch at 50 km/h; this is NOT a demonstrated trimmed cruise condition. Current default allocator cruise result is thrust-supported and does not satisfy the wing-borne cruise target. ATLAS_MVP_07B: three motors per wing (two lift, one cruise), three front motors in a symmetric triangle. Motor 10 is 0.25 m aft of CG on centreline, Z=0; downward exhaust/upward thrust. Mass and inertia retained from baseline; motor-count mass change not estimated. Not flight tested. Centre motor moved aft between wing lift motors on the centreline. Front group changed to four motors in two symmetric pairs; other motors preserved from the active model. Front group now has three motors in a symmetric triangle; CG retained.
